propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built execution system changes to the process engineers' specifications across an electronics manufacturer's two assembly plants for four years under the plant software standard, running every change on the pilot line first under a countersigned pilot record.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change records document the changes and the pilot records.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate taught the supervisors each change on the line during a running shift across sixty-one line sessions with supervisor-signed training records, and released on the execution system lead's go-ahead with the check split recorded.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the training records and the reference call document the line sessions and the go-ahead boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: In the panel exercise the candidate trained the panel on a sample change by showing the new quality hold screen, having each member release a sample hold, pointing out the one step that differed from the old screen, and handing over a one-page card with the three steps.
propositions.rationale: The interviewer note records specific observable behaviour tied to the line training requirement, not an impression.

expectedGap: The change records carry the notes, but the notes for the changes released in the last month are not yet in the materials.
expectedBoundaryNote: Record the interview observation as what was observed in one exercise; do not extend it into a general judgement of the candidate beyond that observation.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the notes of the changes released in the last month.
